class_rules.draft: Declared by W3C CSS-family editor drafts, not vendor, SVG-exclusive, or browser-UI-exclusive.
class_rules.vendor: Property name carries a vendor prefix (-webkit-, -moz-, -ms-, -o-).
class_rules.svg: Declared only by SVG.json, fill-stroke.json, or svg-strokes.json.
class_rules.browser-ui: Declared by css-ui.json, css-forms.json, or compat.json (plus SVG/CSS2 cross-references); no other editor draft owns it.

consolidation.method: Per-spec ed/css JSON files merged by property name. specs lists every declaring spec file; href and value keep the first non-empty entry in file-name order. Prose descriptions are dropped.
